=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27618-27638 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the switch is on and the project has no integration branch, the backward-scan ai:merged branch now calls `_subissue_closing_pr_number`. That call makes new GitHub API requests that the per-tick cache does not serve: 1 `gh pr list --head`, then on a miss 1 timeline fetch plus N `gh api pulls/<n>` reads. The call-site comment ("one lookup") and the agents fragment ("one PR lookup") understate this cost, and there is no §14 audit comment.
  WHY: Each newly reconciled prior-wave item costs 1 to 2+N extra REST calls on the shared rate limit. This breaks P7's "It costs zero new API calls" budget (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md line 111). Severity disagreement: sonnet, gemini, minimax and luna rate it MAJOR; glm rates it NIT because the cost is bounded to once per item. The highest rating is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27614-27638 (helper guard 19773-19805) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The backward scan sets status to "merged" before it records the PR. If `_subissue_closing_pr_number` returns empty or fails, `persist_orch_record_merged_pr` silently returns 0 at the `^[1-9][0-9]*$` guard. A failed state-field write also returns success. Either way `persist_merged_pr` is never written.
  WHY: The scan selects only non-terminal entries (27584, 27597), and the current-wave persist loop writes only `.waves[WAVE_IDX]` (28326), so the field is never retried. Later-wave since-notes then show "merged, PR unknown" permanently for items that merged while the feature was on. All flaggers rate this MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19773-19802 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `persist_orch_record_merged_pr` logs nothing when the PR lookup returns empty. There is no `PERSIST orch_context outcome=skipped reason=pr_invalid`-style line.
  WHY: Together with the no-retry-on-terminal behavior, the missing PR record cannot be seen in workflow logs, so the later "PR unknown" output becomes a silent data-quality problem. Rated MAJOR.
- changelog.d/8427-p7-persist-orch-context.md:2 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The changelog still says "at no extra API cost", although the new backward-scan `_subissue_closing_pr_number` lookup adds calls. The agents fragment's "one PR lookup" also undercounts the real 2+N.
  WHY: Operators and later phases (P8-P10) that budget poller API use from these docs will under-allocate. Severity disagreement: sonnet and gemini rate it NIT; minimax rates it MAJOR. The highest rating is used.
- agents.d/8427-p7-persist-orch-context.md:7 (with scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27618-27638, 27678-27681; tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:29734) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The minimax reviewer says the agents fragment and the test comment have the PR-source mapping swapped relative to the code. In its reading, the early backward-scan path passes `${_pom_bws_pr}` and the `ai:merged` elif passes `${PW_PR}`.
  WHY: Maintainers would reason about the wrong path, and the early path would depend on the lookup that fails silently; the suggested fix is to pass `${PW_PR}` there. Rated MAJOR. Uncertain: sonnet and glm both report that the code refutes this (27634 ai:merged passes `_pom_bws_pr`, 27682 ready-to-merge passes `PW_PR`).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "A new log prefix goes under <!-- agents: section="Stable log prefixes (contractual)" --> as the - `PREFIX` registry bullet plus the `LOG_PREFIX.name=PREFIX` line."

  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The fragment has the `PERSIST` bullet under `Stable log prefixes (contractual)` but no `LOG_PREFIX.name=PERSIST` line, so the assembled agents.md would lack the registration. Disputed: sonnet and glm report that `LOG_PREFIX.name=PERSIST` is already registered at agents.d/8428-persist-attempt-journal.md:16, and that P7 only adds a component to an existing prefix.
- requirement: "The P7 deliverables and tests listed in the plan are implemented and pass." (linked issue #8569 acceptance criteria)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_ai_label_precreation_contract.py, tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py, tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py, tests/test_persist_postmerge_verify.py, tests/test_review_autofix_provider_outoutage_contract.py, tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py, ruff, shellcheck
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The pre-push test gate reports multiple test and lint failures, nine of them attributed to this change, and the last autofix run did not address them. `tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py` fails because `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `docs/INVENTORY.md` are modified outside `files_touched`, and `ruff` and `shellcheck` fail on the new poller and helper additions. Both flaggers rate this BLOCKER. Disputed: sonnet found no code site tying these failures to the diff (the only failing CI check is copilot-pull-request-reviewer with custom_instructions_too_large), and glm could not verify the claim.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27629-27631 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The backward-scan ai:merged `elif [ "${PERSIST_ORCH_CONTEXT_ENABLED:-false}" = "true" ]` branch adds a new `_subissue_closing_pr_number` lookup. Per the helper header (lines 4934-4938) it costs 1 `gh pr list --head` (line 4947), plus on a miss 1 timeline fetch (line 4960) and N `gh api repos/.../pulls/<n>` reads (line 4966). None are cached, the comment says "one lookup", and there is no §14 audit comment.
  WHY: This adds 1 to 2+N REST calls per newly merged prior-wave item, breaking P7's "It costs zero new API calls" (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md line 111; P7 steps at lines 502-509 ask for the PR to come from pr_states). The cost is bounded to once per item. Fix: drop the elif so the item renders "merged, PR unknown", or keep it with a §14 comment stating the 1 + 1 + N bound.
- changelog.d/8427-p7-persist-orch-context.md:2 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The changelog still says "at no extra API cost", and the agents fragment's "API budget" bullet says "one PR lookup", while the real count is up to 2+N (orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4934-4936).
  WHY: Nothing breaks at runtime, but P8-P10 and operators get an API budget that is too low.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh line 27630 comment: no §14 audit comment, and "one lookup" understates the cost. Fix: name what was checked (PERSIST_ORCH_MERGED_PRS_JSON and PR_STATES_JSON cover only the current wave; PRIOR_LABELS_JSON holds labels only) and state the bound of 1 gh pr list + 1 timeline + N pulls. Estimated 3 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
- Rejected pass-1 claims (5 related items):
  - LOG_PREFIX.name=PERSIST is already registered at agents.d/8428-persist-attempt-journal.md line 16.
  - The backward-scan path "swap" is wrong: line 27634 passes `_pom_bws_pr` and line 27682 passes `PW_PR`.
  - The ruff and contract-test failures do not tie to this diff; the only failing CI check is copilot-pull-request-reviewer with custom_instructions_too_large.
  - Luna's "PR never recorded" leads to the documented "PR unknown" fallback, not a correctness bug.
  - `_is_truthy() {` still exists.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27629-27631 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The backward-scan ai:merged path calls _subissue_closing_pr_number, which makes new uncached GitHub API requests (pull list, timeline and PR reads).
  WHY: This consumes extra rate limit on each tick that finds newly merged prior-wave items, violating P7's zero-new-API-calls requirement.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27629-27634 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: If _subissue_closing_pr_number returns empty or fails, or persist_orch_record_merged_pr fails to write state, the PR is never recorded.
  WHY: Only non-terminal entries are processed, so the reconciled item is never revisited and shows "PR unknown" permanently in later-wave since-notes.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27629-27631 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The P7 design needs an unbounded number of extra API calls, depending on how many prior-wave items are reconciled in one tick.
  WHY: This risks exceeding GitHub rate limits when large projects without an integration branch reconcile many items at once.
- changelog.d/8427-p7-persist-orch-context.md:2 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The changelog's "at no extra API cost" is factually wrong given the backward-scan lookups.
  WHY: It misleads operators and P8-P10 implementers about the poller's API budget.
